images.author: Nyttend
images.caption: Front of the Frank Cable House, located at 809 W. Washington Street (U.S. Route 6) in Sandusky, Ohio, United States.  Built in 1895, it is listed on the National Register of Historic Places.

brief: A resort-town cottage lot: Frank Cable House, a 19th-century lake-town house. One photo; year estimated. Older than 1970: northern Michigan resort cottages of this kind are 1880-1950 buildings; Commons has almost no newer ones. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).

facade.notes: the Frank Cable House (Sandusky, 1890s): a rock-faced limestone Queen Anne with a round corner turret with a conical roof, a classical entry porch on paired columns, a wooden fire stair and deck on the side (flats); scaffolding

why.note: Sandusky's own limestone: the 'Stone City' of Lake Erie, quarried under the town
an exterior stair added when cut into flats
